contract.normalization: divide residuals by max absolute residual
contract.domain: alpha,gamma unrestricted; beta in [0,1); exact beta=0 face plus interior

cases.name: leveraged
cases.purpose: Interior EGARCH fit with negative leverage coefficient gamma.

cases.name: leveraged_reflected
cases.purpose: Exact sign reflection; gamma must change sign and all variance results remain equal.

cases.name: gamma_zero
cases.purpose: Data generated with symmetric-news gamma equal to zero.

cases.name: beta_zero
cases.purpose: Exact beta=0 face with a nonnegative one-sided KKT derivative.

cases.name: near_integrated
cases.purpose: Attained high-persistence optimum, separated from the open beta=1 boundary.

cases.name: constant_failure
cases.purpose: Demeaning makes scale zero, so volatility parameters are unidentified.
cases.failure: demeaned maximum absolute residual is zero

cases.name: long_quiet_extreme
cases.purpose: Decimal remains finite while binary64 standardized-square replay reaches +infinity.

precision_recheck.comparison: raw Decimal trees compared before canonical formatting

binary64_replay.canonical_measurements: none; host observations are printed by deep-check
binary64_replay.extended_real_rule: math.exp overflow is ordered +infinity, never NaN or an exception

rust_kernel_tolerances.measurement_basis: measured against the Rust EGARCH kernel replay
rust_kernel_tolerances.certification: empirical Rust binary64 errors, not Decimal certification
rust_kernel_tolerances.tolerance_policy: approximately four times each measured maximum

rust_fit_tolerances.measurement_basis: measured against the Rust EGARCH fit and forecast replay
rust_fit_tolerances.certification: empirical Rust optimizer errors, not Decimal certification
rust_fit_tolerances.tolerance_policy: current Rust tests use approximately four times each measured maximum
